commands.name: rust-validation
commands.cmd:
set -e
cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --offline -p rustty-vt --lib --test batched_input --test charsets --test grapheme_wrap --test hyperlinks --test shared_hyperlinks --test page_lifecycle --test feed_boundaries --test text_sizing --test snapshot --test semantic > /private/tmp/rustty-reintegrate.leadij/linked-final-tests.log 2>&1
cargo +1.95.0 clippy --locked --offline -p rustty-vt --all-targets -- -D warnings > /private/tmp/rustty-reintegrate.leadij/linked-final-clippy.log 2>&1
GHOSTTY_PRIMITIVES_BIN=/Users/byron/dev/github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/zig-out/bin/vt-primitives cargo +1.95.0 bench --locked --offline -p rustty-vt --bench primitives -- reflow_history_content/mixed-dense-links --test > /private/tmp/rustty-reintegrate.leadij/linked-final-dense-reflow.log 2>&1
cargo +1.95.0 fmt -p rustty-vt -- --check > /private/tmp/rustty-reintegrate.leadij/linked-final-format.log 2>&1
git diff --check >> /private/tmp/rustty-reintegrate.leadij/linked-final-format.log 2>&1
